# Actual local OCI conversion and filesystem reconstruction — 2026-10-29

All four built candidates now pass actual pinned Skopeo1.22.2 conversion and umoci0.6.0 rootless unpack plus independent descriptor, DiffID, complete path/file/mode/mtime/link and rooted application-alias checks. Final producer4 checks/19 controls/4 images,63.790s; whole pinned command63.986s. This completes the observed local additive-filesystem subset, not Phase2, runtime, legal, independent custody or whole-image reproducibility acceptance.

[Execution and retained failure logs](../evidence/t02/image-layout-logs/09dc6c404fcdb383495da1acec36d12e082e604a423194fcfa585fd6bb9fd33f.json) distinguish measured whole-command time from the report's63.788s prepublication observation. ## Demonstrated defects and controls

The initial10 controls failed because the producer was absent. Further failing controls cover actual timestamp spelling, gzip media mismatch, omitted root-directory metadata and shared-filesystem publication; final19 pass. The42 combined archive/payload/layout controls and deployment evaluation16 checks/31 controls2.722s also pass. The four candidate output paths remain exactly unchanged after adding a separate inspection-tool shell/package; flake.lock is unchanged and no tool enters a runtime image.

Skopeo changes RFC3339 UTC spellings from+00:00 toZ, including history creation times (41 app/worker,52 PostgreSQL,12 gateway). The verifier preserves both complete raw configurations and digests, records each demonstrated spelling change and rejects other configuration changes, changed instants or unknown transformations. No payload mismatch is normalized. The optional accept-uncompressed conversion produced a gzip media label with uncompressed tar bytes in this actual run; its failure is retained. Explicit forced gzip conversion now passes media/header/hash/DiffID checks; this is an observed tool invocation correction, not a provider or version-wide guarantee.

The archive's explicit `.` root directory was initially omitted from the filesystem walk, causing the exact path-set check to fail. It now participates in metadata comparison. App/worker reconstruct the same filesystem, so their identical compressed manifest is stored once. The original publisher failed on a second exclusive creation after writing a report prematurely. Its [failed attempt and immutable diagnostic](../evidence/t02/image-layout-revisions/381797ced2867c9cc92392c7a9c4cf6998fe519db3629231ba7084e3e753f7f4/attempt-failed.json) are retained. The publisher now validates content addresses/conflicts before writing, deduplicates exact bytes, verifies every unique payload before writing the report last and refuses existing records. Final independent readback verifies all report/source/OCI-document/filesystem hashes and counts; the three unique filesystem payloads are complete. Temporary image-layout children are gone; every pre-existing directory mode is unchanged.

The checkout's /home/claude parents are owned by another identity with0750, so the mapped unprivileged tool could not traverse them. The producer accepts an explicit existing dedicated owned nonsymlink scratch parent and never changes permissions. Actual work used new exclusive children under /var/lib/shop-image-scratch-VjIrVLVQ/phase2-image-tools-20261029-c8m98s11; only this turn's new tool-build child was created. The parent retains0711. Each tool runs as UID/GID1000 in a fresh user/network namespace with closed local archive/OCI arguments, empty auth/config and a local-only trust policy. Namespace identity was separately observed; acquisition was bounded max-jobs1/cores2/600s and measured0.214s after the13 announced binary fetches (dry-run estimate22.0MiB download/63.1MiB unpacked). No shared temp/cache cleanup, protected-service or provider action occurred.

## Reproduction and remaining acceptance

Use `nix develop ./ops/nixos#images --command python3 scripts/check_image_layout.py --build-index docs/evidence/t02/image-build-revisions/9d42b9f045e228de2d03e99bfe97e222295885ab8810861caca57d2c9e994102.json --scratch-parent /path/to/dedicated/owned/parent --record-evidence`. The parent must be caller-owned, nonsymlink, not group/world-writable, have more than1GiB free and be traversable by the isolated tool. New temporary children alone are removed. In this checkout use the existing owned TMPDIR/XDG cache described in the [current payload report](current-payload-reproducibility-2026-10-29.md); do not change a canonical build input silently or clear shared resources.

Skopeo produces actual local OCI manifests with verified descriptors, not a registry publication. umoci rootless reconstruction can approximate ownership/xattrs, so UID/GID mapping, all kernel/runtime/storage/namespace/cgroup semantics, native licences, independent custody and actual rootless services remain unqualified. The temporary OCI layers/bundles were removed after verification; retained metadata/manifests are not an off-host recoverable runtime artifact set. Two independent image builds have not yet been compared. deployment-build/boot and full reproducibility remain closed. Full plan records remain8/18; BUILD and related11/12/13/14 qualification gates remain open in the [completion tracker](../../.planning/phases/02-reproducible-application-and-deployment-skeleton/02-COMPLETION-TRACKER.md).

Primary references: [OCI1.1.1 layer semantics](https://github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/blob/v1.1.1/layer.md), [OCI image layout](https://github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/blob/v1.1.1/image-layout.md), [Skopeo1.22.2 copy](https://github.com/containers/skopeo/blob/v1.22.2/docs/skopeo-copy.1.md), [umoci0.6.0 unpack/rootless limits](https://github.com/opencontainers/umoci/blob/v0.6.0/doc/man/umoci-unpack.1.md). The standard tools apply the layers; project code verifies their actual output instead of extracting tar paths itself.
